blocks.note: Read cardinal and ordinal values in connected Spanish while preserving agreement and the conventions of each numerical context.
Choose cien, ciento, or cientos from the number's syntactic role and the material that follows it.
Translate ordinal meanings with the appropriate agreement, apocope, and preference for cardinal forms in higher positions.
Name common fractions accurately and distinguish compact mathematical nouns from everyday parte expressions.
Integrate percentages, arithmetic, fractions, dimensions, temperatures, and other numerical expressions in full sentences.
